jobs.description:
For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver – Sea Container Transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

You will transport sea containers on dedicated shuttle and short-haul routes between the major port terminals and various warehouses throughout the Port of Antwerp.

As the majority of your work involves local shuttle runs between warehouses and terminals, you can avoid long motorway traffic jams while keeping your schedule tight, efficient, and predictable.

You will work confidently with the various terminal systems and carefully check all container and seal numbers to ensure everything is correct.

Thanks to flexible departure locations, you can also avoid unnecessary commuting time. In consultation with the planning team, you can start from a strategic location in the port that is most convenient for you.

An average working day is approximately 12 hours. However, if you prefer a better work-life balance, a 4/5 employment arrangement or part-time schedule is absolutely negotiable.

You will join a stable, permanent position with a clear focus on reliable, long-term cooperation.

 Requirements 

    
• Qualifications: You hold a valid CE driving licence and an up-to-date Code 95 qualification.
    
• Language skills: You speak and understand Dutch or English well enough to communicate smoothly and effectively.
    
• Administration: You ensure the accurate and correct handling of CMR consignment notes and terminal documentation.
    
• Professional attitude: You are a serious, reliable professional who always works in a customer-friendly and presentable manner.

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

You will spend around 90% of your time in the field. Working with a colleague, you will carry out maintenance, inspections and technical interventions on specialised installations in the rail environment. Most assignments are in Antwerp, Brussels and Ghent, with additional interventions elsewhere. 
 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on technical installations. 
• Analyse and resolve mechanical, electromechanical and electrical faults. 
• Assess technical situations independently and help determine the appropriate course of action. 
• Carry out measurements, inspections and interventions using professional tools and test equipment. 
• Liaise with colleagues, engineers and project managers. 
• Depending on your experience, coordinate activities and take a leading role in the field.  
Rail experience is an advantage, but not essential. You bring a solid technical background and relevant practical experience; Buhlmann will teach you the specific installations, procedures and safety requirements of the rail environment. Experience in industrial maintenance, machine building, installation engineering or field service can be highly relevant.
 
After your induction period, you will take part in the on-call rota. Urgent night-time interventions are limited to a few occasions per year. In addition, there is on average around one planned night intervention per month, with time off in lieu afterwards.

We are looking for an experienced technician who knows the trade, can tackle technical problems independently and takes responsibility for safe, high-quality execution. 
 
• Technical qualification in electromechanics, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent experience. 
• Several years of relevant practical experience in maintenance, industrial installations, machine building, field service or a comparable technical environment. 
• Strong foundation in mechanics and electromechanics, complemented by sufficient electrical knowledge. 
• You analyse problems methodically, work independently and consult others when the situation requires it. 
• You enjoy field work and are comfortable in a role involving travel to different sites. 
• Experience as a lead technician, team leader or site supervisor is an advantage; even in such a role, you still want to remain technically involved. 
• You can communicate operationally in Dutch and/or French and have sufficient English for technical communication.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Officer - Technical Sales Support & Logistics
jobs.description:
Navision, order processing and follow-up form the core of the role – but the position is clearly broader than traditional order administration. 

As Administrative Officer – Technical Sales Support & Logistics, you are a key link between customers, suppliers and your colleagues. As you gain experience, you can also become more involved in logistics follow-up and the administrative support of technical projects.
  
• Process and follow up customer orders in Microsoft Dynamics Navision. 
• Prepare quotations, order confirmations and purchase orders. 
• Place orders with suppliers and actively follow up delivery dates. 
• Support customers with questions about parts, spare parts and service. 
• Request prices and quotations from suppliers. 
• Follow up transport, deliveries, incoming goods and stock information. 
• Work closely with sales, project managers, engineers and technicians. 
• Occasionally provide practical support with a delivery or in the warehouse.  
The practical logistics component is limited – around 5 to 10% of the role – but it reflects the way Buhlmann works: colleagues do not constantly draw a line around where one job description ends and another begins.
 
Once you know the organisation well, your responsibilities can expand towards project support, for example project files in SharePoint, material orders, delivery follow-up and administrative preparation for invoicing.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is administratively strong, takes responsibility and shows initiative. 

You preferably have relevant experience in order administration, purchasing, sales support, customer service, logistics administration or a technical sales support role. You do not need to be a technical specialist, but an interest in a technical environment is important.
  
• Experience with an ERP system; knowledge of Navision is a strong advantage. SAP or a comparable system also provides a good basis. 
• You work accurately and in a structured way and can keep several files, deliveries and deadlines under control at the same time. 
• You take initiative: if a supplier needs to be chased or a file needs further investigation, you do not simply wait. 
• You are collegial and practically minded and do not mind occasionally helping with a delivery. 
• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate professionally in English. French is a clear advantage; German is a welcome extra.

You will work closely with one or several Client Relationship Managers and play a key role in ensuring excellent service delivery to clients.

Your responsibilities as Client Administration Officer

As a Client Administration Officer, you will provide comprehensive administrative support while ensuring a high level of service to both clients and internal stakeholders.

Administrative & Executive Support

• Managing complex agendas and coordinating meetings
• Screening and handling calls, emails, and correspondence
• Welcoming clients and visitors
• Organizing meeting rooms and coordinating logistics
• Preparing presentations and administrative documentation
• Managing and maintaining client files and archives
• Ensuring smooth communication between clients, advisors, and internal teams
• Maintaining and updating client information in internal databases
Client & Financial Administration

• Supporting the opening of bank accounts in coordination with Compliance
• Following up on investment-related administrative processes
• Processing and monitoring financial transactions and investment orders
• Preparing reports, dashboards, and administrative analyses
• Ensuring accurate and compliant client documentation
• Supporting advisors in the day-to-day management of client relationships

Your profile as Client Administration Officer

• Bachelor in Office Management, Management Assistant, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar administrative support role
• Experience within a professional services environment (financial services, consulting, legal, wealth management, etc.) is a strong asset
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch, with a good command of French and English
• Strong administrative and organizational skills
• Affinity with numbers and financial environments
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy
• Service-oriented, proactive, and solution-driven mindset
• High level of discretion and professionalism
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
• Experience with CRM systems or databases is an asset

Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.
They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details

Are you passionate about connecting top talent with exciting career opportunities? This role combines end-to-end recruitment with operational HR support, offering variety, ownership, and direct business impact.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• Operating and monitoring packaging machines and equipment.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request
